messages:
lee: quick heads up: reproducing double-charge when stream reconnect + server-side truncation. short thread.
anya: repro steps?
lee: client starts stream, server triggers truncation (policy=max_tokens), client reconnects to resume, and ratecheck charges prefix again. sample: `billing.v1: +36 tokens` then `+36` after resume.
anya: is truncation happening server-initiated or client-side?
lee: server-initiated on long outputs. toolcall gets aborted, resume flows treat it as new session.
devops-bot: Suggest tagging route and enabling debug-logs for 5m.
anya: short-term mitigation: mark truncation-resume flows as provisional in billing pipeline and exclude provisional from quota enforcement. long term: ensure truncation includes resume-stable metadata (session_id or resume_token) to dedupe.
lee: edge: if toolcall billed before truncation, resumed request shouldn't rebill toolcall cost. persist `toolcall_id` in session KV on start.
billing-bot: Created billing rule: auto-flag truncation-resume duplicates (threshold=2 matches/30s).
anya: plan: console add filter `truncation_resume=true` and provisional column. runtime: resume dedupe POC next sprint behind flag. assignments: anya -> console telemetry, lee -> runtime POC, billing-bot -> detection rule.
